comment: Terminology of this translation. A term is matched in the English (case-insensitive, at a word start); the Turkish should then contain one of 'tr' (Turkish-aware, so suffixes such as -'ın / -lar still match) and none of 'avoid'. 'status': 'approved' = the person's decision (tools never change it), 'proposed' = a suggestion (from a model or a reviewer) waiting for a decision. Mismatches are warnings in validate and in the review queue, never errors.

terms.note: a name: keep it; suffix with an apostrophe (Rayman'ın)

speakers.comment: What the speaker codes of the voice files (column 'speakers', a four-letter code) mean to you, once you know. The tools never guess them.
